pick: sha256('known-slice-v2:<row>') ascending, first 100 that pass the filters
filters: known_slice_v1's filters unchanged (health/diet/fitness/mood/medical, answers that change over time, time-sensitive wording, first gold answer at most 4 words, no world or never-told names: 47 tokens)
form: the question with its first letter capitalized and a question mark, asked bare in the product form
use: a second known slice (lead, 30 Oct 06:02): used in the keep rule only if the owner picks the known rule; else shown beside honesty-3; frozen by hash before any answer
